title: Senior Practice Lead/Director [Data and AI Service Line] IRC299362
description: DescriptionKey RequirementsStrategic Thinking: A proven ability to think strategically while maintaining a strong technical aptitude in Data Engineering, Analytics, and Generative AI.Communication: Exceptional presentation and public speaking abilities, with the skill to articulate complex value propositions to C-level stakeholders.Collaboration: Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of collaborating with diverse global stakeholders.Analytical Rigor: Strong problem-solving and prioritization skills to manage competing demands across practice building and sales support.Tools: Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Excel.RequirementsJob DescriptionKey Responsibilities Capability Building & Technology Expertise (50%)Practice Leadership: Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Data and AI Service Line, staying ahead of market trends and emerging technologies.Innovation & Offerings: Develop differentiated solution offerings, high-impact use cases, and compelling capability presentations that position GlobalLogic as a leader in AI.Talent Mentorship: Foster a proactive learning mindset within the team, encouraging the expansion of technical knowledge and mastery of new AI frameworks.Asset Creation: Oversee the development of reusable frameworks, accelerators, and a comprehensive insights database to leverage institutional knowledge. Presales & Strategic Partnership (25%)Solution Architecture: Partner with pre-sales and account leadership to anchor medium to large-scale opportunities, translating intricate AI strategies into persuasive proposal narratives.Bid Strategy: Lead the end-to-end proposal development process for Data-centric RFIs and RFPs, ensuring the delivery of winning, client-centric solutions.Executive Facilitation: Lead strategic review sessions with senior leadership, outlining proposed technical solutions, delivery approaches, and commercial viability. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!About GlobalLogicGlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
